titulo: 'The last thing you expect': Locals near UK airbase react to 'terrorist act' arrests
cuerpo: British police were questioning five men on Monday on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offences after they were detained near an air base that has been used by the US to strike Iran. Residents of a village that's situated under a mile away from the base were ordered to evacuate on Sunday as the investigation continues, with many left taken aback by the developments.
